THE FORT · ARRANGE IT

Every piece of the fort is here on its own: the boards on the wall, the tent, the lab, the heroes, the men, the pets, the hangar and the signs. Drag any piece with a finger to a new place.

Tap a piece to pick it: the arrows nudge it one step (×10 for big steps), FORWARD and BACK put it in front of or behind its neighbours, HIDE takes it off, RESET puts it back where the game has it.

The sky, the wall and the ground are locked so a drag on them moves the view instead. PIECES lists everything: the eye shows or hides a piece, the lock frees it. The night's torches, brazier and lanterns are in the list too, turned off.

📱 PHONE shows the window Wyatt's phone sees (and swiped east to the hangar). Two fingers zoom; one finger on the ground moves the view.

Your work saves itself on this device. When you like it, SEND MY LAYOUT makes a picture and a small file of every move; send both on WhatsApp and the build puts the fort that way.
